reader.requirement: At --std 85, with format 3, integer-4 and integer-5 only refer to (document) the smallest and largest record sizes; the size of each record is the one its record description entry defines (fixed part plus the current ODO occurrences), so no record is refused or resized against the integers, and 1985 prints no syntax rule for format 3, so integer-4 >= integer-5 is accepted.

edition-consulted.switches: BoundsEnforced via DialectBehavior.RecordContainsRangeBindsRecordSize (2002+); at 85 false, so VaryMin/VaryMax take the smallest/largest record description instead of integer-4/integer-5
edition.DialectLevel >= Since: format 3's integer-5 > integer-4 rule (§2002:13.16.41.2 SR8 / §2023:13.18.43.3 SR9) is screened only from 2002

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 records outside integer-4..integer-5 are written at their own size and 10 TO 5 / 5 TO 5 compile; at 2023 such records get I-O status 44 and the reversed or equal integers are refused (COBOL2009).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1c23 covers records whose sizes coincide with the integers; descriptions outside the range, ODO records, reversed/equal integers and non-sequential organizations are exercised only by the probes.

probes.expected: each record's size is completely defined by its description (GR14)

reader.notes: The 85 arm is its own (BoundsEnforced false, RecordClauseRules gated from 2002), and probes show it does what the 1985 text says: the integers document sizes and constrain nothing, ODO records are sized by their current occurrences, and the reversed and equal integer forms that 2002 began to refuse are accepted.
reader.at-2023: out-of-range records 44; 10 TO 5 and 5 TO 5 refused COBOL2009

refuter.evidence: The reader's requirement sizes a format 3 record at 'fixed part plus the current ODO occurrences'. The 1985 text under the same FORMAT 3 heading defines that size otherwise: GR15 'The size of a record is determined by the sum of the number of characters in all fixed length elementary items plus the sum of the maximum number of characters in any variable length item subordinate to the record', and §1985:VI.5.8.4 GR5 makes an ODO record variable length only when the FD 'contains the VARYING phrase of the RECORD clause'; GR15's 'may be different from the actual size' points only to character representation, SYNCHRONIZED and USAGE. Probe refute-1985-023/rr1.cob at --std 85: record 05 R3-N PIC 99, 05 R3-T PIC XX OCCURS 1 TO 4 DEPENDING ON N3 (max 10), N3=1. FD RECORD CONTAINS 4 TO 10: bytes 04 00 00 00 31 32 41 42 (written at 4, the current occurrences); the same record under RECORD CONTAINS 10 and under no RECORD clause: 10 bytes '12AB      '. So at 85 the format 3 ODO record is written at a size its record description does not define per GR14/GR15 (10). Same output at --std 2023 (the 2023 current-occurrence sizing): the 85 path has no arm of its own. The code-location the reader names (FileControlBinder.FileSection.cs#BindRecordClause, FileModel.cs#VaryMin/#MinRecordSize) is exactly the site of the open defect kb/Work/PB5731 ('sized with the table at its MINIMUM occurrences, where §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR15 sizes it at the maximum'; its sweep names 'the record size checks of WRITE and RELEASE'). cite.py: OK §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR14 (the text is in GR14); OK §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR15 (the text is in GR15); OK §1985:VI.5.8.4 GR5 (the text is in GR5). The integers-document-only half and the 10 TO 5 / 5 TO 5 acceptance stand (reader's rec1/rec3).
edition-sites-missed: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/Model/FileModel.cs#VaryMin: below 2002 (BoundsEnforced false) answers Records.Min(MinRecordSize), the ODO table at its minimum occurrences, where 1985 format 3 (GR15) needs the maximum; the WRITE length follows the 2023 current-occurrence rule at 85
refuter.corrected: Non-conforming at --std 85 (cause c, with a: 85 needs a format 3 sizing arm of its own): a format 3 record with an OCCURS DEPENDING ON table is sized by its current (and, for VaryMin, minimum) occurrences instead of GR15's maximum, so the WRITE releases 4 bytes of a 10-byte record. Harm: wrong-answer on the medium (record length), plus PB5731's under-rejects / rejects-legal-source in SORT GIVING and SD checks. Known note: kb/Work/PB5731 (open).

adjudication.reason: The mechanism of the open kb/Work PB5731 (a format 3 record with an OCCURS DEPENDING ON table is sized at the table's minimum at 85); this row adds a run-time consumer: WRITE puts out a 4-character record where `§1985:VII.3.8.4 GR15` makes it 10.
